model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: MINI USA 2027 Countryman SE ALL4 technical specs, 'A: Overall Length: 175 in' (whole inches).
length_in.discrepancy: C/D lists 174.5 in (2026 SE ALL4). MINI's figure appears rounded to the inch.

width_in.note: Secondary source for the mirrorless figure: C/D 'Width, without mirrors', 2026 SE ALL4. MINI USA gives only 'C: Overall Width including mirrors: 81.5 in'.

awd.note: Only US electric version is the SE ALL4: 'ALL4: Intelligent All-Wheel Drive'. C/D's only trim is 'Countryman SE ALL4'.

adapter.note: 'With a compatible adapter, MINI EV drivers can now charge at Tesla Supercharger stations'. Whether it's included or sold isn't stated on this page.

charge_port.note: MINI doesn't name the port; CCS1 inferred from the adapter requirement for Superchargers.

us_status.note: 'The 2027 MINI Countryman SE ALL4 ... starts at $45,200.'

entries.note: '64.7 kWh Battery Capacity'. MINI's specs FAQ says the same. C/D's review says 64.6.
'29 min 10-80% battery state of charge with DC Fast Charging'. FAQ on the same page: 'as little as 30 minutes'. Charger power not stated.
Not in the text of MINI's Countryman pages, including the compare page rendered in a browser on 2026-09-19 (no heat pump row).

cargo_cu_ft.note: 'Cargo Capacity (cu Ft)' 24.83-56.18 in the SE ALL4 column of MINI's compare page, read in the browser (the table renders client-side). C/D's 24.8 / 56.2 are the same figures rounded.

turning_circle_ft.note: C/D; MINI's compare page, read in the browser on 2026-09-19, has no turning circle row.

ground_clearance_in.note: C/D; MINI's compare page, read in the browser on 2026-09-19, has no ground clearance row.

powertrain.text: No separate powertrain warranty; New Vehicle Warranty 4 years/50,000 miles (MY2025 warranty book)

warranty.note: Battery from the 2027 Countryman page FAQ; new-vehicle term from https://www.miniusa.com/content/dam/mini/PDF/warranties/2025_Model_Warranty_Book.pdf (the 2026 and 2027 books returned 404).

highway_tests.note: C/D 75-mph highway range test. Temperature not stated.

notes.text: Cargo is MINI's figure from its compare page. Turning circle and ground clearance are Car and Driver's; MINI's compare page has no rows for them.
Port type is inferred; MINI says an adapter is needed for Superchargers but not whether one is included.
